title: לילה טוב, טוהר והלני
subtitle: ספר רגוע לפני השינה

day.tohar: a soft cream romper with short puffy sleeves.
day.heleni: a dusty-pink cotton dress with a small ruffle at the shoulders.

night.tohar: sage-green footed pajamas with tiny pale-yellow stars.
night.heleni: dusty-pink pajamas with tiny cream crescent moons.

coverScene: Tohar and Heleni in pajamas sitting close together on a wide window seat at night, seen from inside a cozy bedroom, looking up at a big round pale-yellow full moon in a deep dusty-blue sky with a few soft stars. Heleni's arm is around Tohar.

pages.text:
השמש יורדת.
השמיים ורודים.
טוהר והלני עוד משחקות.
pages.scene: Early evening in a cozy children's room. Through a large window the sky is dusty pink and orange at sunset. Heleni stacks wooden blocks on a soft rug while Tohar sits beside her holding one block.

pages.text:
מי מציץ בחלון?
ירח עגול וקטן.
pages.scene: The sky in the window has turned soft violet. A small round pale-yellow moon peeks in at the corner of the window. Heleni points up at it in surprise; Tohar looks up with wide curious eyes.

pages.text:
הלני מנופפת: שלום, שלום!
טוהר צוחקת: דָּא! דָּא!
pages.scene: Both girls stand at the low window sill, seen from the side. Heleni waves at the moon with one hand. Tohar holds the sill with both hands and laughs, mouth open in joy.

pages.text:
הירח לוחש:
שששש... כבר ערב.
בואו נגיד לילה טוב.
pages.scene: Close view of the moon glowing softly in a darkening dusty-blue sky, its gentle light falling into the room onto the two girls' upturned faces, seen from behind and slightly to the side.

pages.text:
לילה טוב, דובי.
דובי מפהק: אָאָאָה...
pages.scene: Heleni tucks a small brown teddy bear under a tiny blanket in a doll bed. Tohar pats the teddy's head gently. The teddy looks sleepy.

pages.text:
לילה טוב, ארנב.
ארנב מתכרבל: מממ...
pages.scene: Tohar hugs a soft grey plush bunny with long floppy ears against her cheek, eyes half closed. Heleni kneels beside her, smiling and stroking the bunny's ear.

pages.text:
לילה טוב, כדור.
הכדור נח בפינה.
pages.scene: A soft striped ball rests in a wicker toy basket in the corner of the room. Heleni places it gently; Tohar crawls toward the basket, looking at the ball.

pages.text:
לילה טוב, ספרים.
ישנים על המדף.
pages.scene: A low wooden bookshelf with a row of colorful picture books with blank spines. Heleni slides the last book into place on tiptoe. Tohar sits on the rug watching, one finger raised.

pages.text:
שוטפות ידיים ופנים.
פְּלִיק, פְּלַק, טיפות!
pages.scene: A small cozy bathroom with warm light. Heleni stands on a wooden step stool at the sink with her hands under a gentle stream of water, a few round droplets in the air. Tohar sits on a fluffy bath mat beside the stool holding a small towel, giggling.

pages.text:
פיג'מה רכה.
יד אחת, יד שתיים.
הופ!
pages.scene: Both girls now in their pajamas in the bedroom. Heleni proudly stretches both arms up in the air. Tohar sits and looks down at her own pajama sleeve, pulling at it with delight.
Heleni leans over and kisses Tohar on her round cheek. Tohar scrunches her eyes shut and smiles. Soft lamp light, tender close-up from the waist up.

pages.text:
טוהר נותנת להלני חיבוק.
חזק, חזק.
pages.scene: Tohar wraps her short arms around Heleni's middle and presses her cheek against her. Heleni hugs her back with eyes closed, smiling. Both sit on a soft blanket.

The window at night, deep dusty-blue sky with three soft glowing stars and the moon. The two girls are seen from behind, small silhouettes sitting side by side on the window seat, Heleni pointing at the stars.

pages.text:
הירח מאיר על החדר,
אור רך כמו שמיכה.
pages.scene: Wide view of the quiet bedroom at night. Pale moonlight falls through the window across two small beds side by side, the toys asleep on the shelf. The girls are in their beds under soft blankets, still awake, looking at each other.
Close view of both girls lying in their beds, heads on pillows turned toward each other, eyelids heavy and almost closed. Tohar holds the grey bunny. Very dim, warm, calm light.

pages.text:
לילה טוב, טוהר.
לילה טוב, הלני.
חלומות מתוקים.
pages.scene: Both girls fast asleep in their beds under soft blankets, peaceful faces, eyes closed. The moon watches through the window, the room dark dusty blue with a faint warm night-light glow. Very still and quiet.
